# Join Lightning Mesh

> Step-by-step instructions for joining a Lightning Mesh network: a decentralized router mesh (OpenWrt routers, 802.11s backhaul, babel routing, CRDT coordination, iroh transport) with a local front desk at http://hello.mesh. Written for people and agents from one Markdown source. Every page has YAML frontmatter (id, path, status: built|partial|coming-soon, requires, next_step, verified_against) and every step is Do / Expect / If not. Only `built` and `partial` pages describe deployed behavior. Paths below are relative to this file (docs-web/content/join/ in https://github.com/WorldTreeNetwork/lightning-mesh).

Verified against commit 2f6dc6b (2026-09-24), docs rewrite vs current hello.mesh UI.

## Start

- [Overview](index.md): stock vs pre-flashed vs walk-up phone; what works today

## New house, pre-flashed router (read in order)

- [Unbox](house/01-unbox.md): if no `⚡`/`Lightning Mesh` after 2 min, it is stock — flash path; optional WAN; ignore `mjolnir-mesh`; one radio
- [First hour](house/02-first-hour.md): `10.42.x`; http://hello.mesh; Apps/Services/Routers; identity optional
- [How it works](house/03-how-it-works.md): client AP vs 802.11s; addresses; roaming (DHCP keep-IP, sessions can drop); directory
- [Administer](house/04-administer.md): overlay SSH; WPS WAN window; Lightning Admin = client SSID only; gateway auto/never
- [Share a service](house/05-services.md): Apps vs Services; `mjolnir-meshd publish`; `app=v1` for the shelf
- [Add another router](house/06-add-router.md): PARTIAL — matching wireless.env + **manual peer ids on both boxes**; roam after join

## Join with a phone or laptop (read in order)

- [Connect to the Wi-Fi](person/01-connect.md): open SSID; one radio; `10.42.x`; roaming caveats
- [Say hello](person/02-hello-mesh.md): http://hello.mesh tour (People, Apps, Services, Routers, Stamp location); GPS often blocked on http
- [Create your identity](person/03-identity.md): IdentiKey, 24-word phrase, soft custody
- [Sign in to mesh apps](person/04-sign-in.md): `/assert` tab flow **and** Apps-card consent sheet
- [Find services](person/05-services.md): Apps shelf vs Services; cert warnings; no UI to claim a name
- [Take your identity with you](person/06-leave.md): export/restore; cannot delete from mesh yet
- [Troubleshooting](person/troubleshooting.md): DNS, blackhole, Apps missing, GPS stamp, roam, LEDs, agent curls

## Bring a router (operators, read in order)

- [Choose a router and flash OpenWrt](node/01-hardware-and-flash.md): skip if already pre-flashed; Cudy MT7981 fleet; LFS intermediates; USB RT5370 for client AP on single-radio
- [Install](node/02-install.md): build.sh, build-hello.sh, wireless.env, install-node.sh
- [Join the mesh](node/03-join-the-mesh.md): `uci add_list mjolnir.meshd.peer` both ways; no membership gate
- [Operate](node/04-operate.md): 10.254 overlay; WPS WAN SSH; names; gateway auto/never

## Publish a service (operators and developers)

- [Publish a service](publish/01-publish-a-service.md): `mjolnir-meshd publish` on the router (not `meshd`); `--txt app=v1`; key-owned `/api/challenge` + `/api/name-claim`
- [Mini-apps](publish/02-mini-apps.md): BUILT — `app=v1`, router-fetched `/.well-known/mesh-app.json`, Apps shelf, sandboxed card, postMessage identity

## Optional

- [Contribute](contribute.md): AGPL, CLA, beads, editing this guide
- Maintainer docs (not on the public site): identity-assertion, mesh-app-publishing, node-operations under `docs/` on GitHub
